title: Consolidated Data Model
description: Consolidated entity schemas from data model files

name.description: Project (field) name; primary key. Example: 'Julia' or 'Penguins'.

operator.description: Name of the company operating the development.

budget.description: Approved capital budget for the development, in millions of US dollars.

milestones.description: Lifecycle milestones for this project, from discovery through end-of-life.

partners.description: Joint-venture partners holding an equity stake in this project.

production.description: Annual production figures for this project, one record per calendar year.

project.description: An oil & gas subsea tieback development, identified by the field/project name. Carries the approved capital budget and the set of lifecycle milestones for the development.

name.description: Owning project name; foreign key to project.name. Matches the parent PK field name so it materializes the nesting under project.milestones.

phase.description: Recognized lifecycle phase this milestone marks.

milestone_key.description: Composite primary key: the owning project plus the lifecycle phase, so each project has at most one milestone per recognized phase.

date.description: Calendar date the milestone is (or is planned to be) reached, as YYYY-MM-DD.

milestone.description: A dated phase gate in a subsea tieback's life (discovery, appraisal, FID, first oil, end-of-life). Belongs to a project and nests under project.milestones.

name.description: Owning project name; foreign key to project.name. Matches the parent PK field name so it materializes the nesting under project.partners.

partner_key.description: Composite primary key: the owning project plus the partner company name, so each partner appears at most once per project.

participation.description: Partner's equity stake in the project, as a percentage (0-100).

partner.description: A company holding an equity stake in a project. Belongs to a project and nests under project.partners. Participation percentages within a project are expected to sum to 100.

name.description: Owning project name; foreign key to project.name. Matches the parent PK field name so it materializes the nesting under project.production.

year.description: Calendar year the production figures apply to.

production_key.description: Composite primary key: the owning project plus the calendar year, so each project has at most one production record per year.

oil_kbbd.description: Average crude oil production for the year, in thousands of barrels per day (kbbd). Optional; omit if not produced or not reported.

condensate_kbbd.description: Average condensate production for the year, in thousands of barrels per day (kbbd). Optional; omit if not produced or not reported.

gas_mmscfd.description: Average natural gas production for the year, in millions of standard cubic feet per day (MMscfd). Optional; omit if not produced or not reported.

production.description: Annual production figures for a subsea tieback, one record per calendar year. Belongs to a project and nests under project.production. Individual stream volumes are optional so a year can report any subset of oil, condensate and gas.

change.description: Change log entry describing a versioned modification to the consolidated data model or data.

git_commit_hash.description: Git commit hash corresponding to this change
